notes: Phonon-2.5 English for LiteRT (litert-community/Phonon-2.5-English): FermionResearch/Phonon-2.5-English (revision da200358, CC-BY-4.0) is an English-only model in the architecture and with the tokenizer of nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3 (a 24-layer encoder and a TDT decoder); its container has the layout of FermionResearch/Phonon-2's: the encoder's linear weights stored as five values per output row and the other large weights as 6-bit tables. These files expand them to float16 (the f16 forms, for the GPU and the NPU) or int8 (the i8 form, for the CPU, quantized with ai-edge-quantizer 0.10.0), exported with litert-torch 0.9.4 into raw LiteRT graphs by the same code as litert-community/Phonon-2's: one encoder file per form holding the seven signatures enc5 / enc7.5 / enc10 / enc15 / enc20 / enc25 / enc30 (f16, f16 compiled ahead of time for the SM8850, i8; a window runs in the smallest length that holds it, with a valid-length mel mask), a log-mel graph per window length and one int8 TDT decoder (the mel graphs and the decoder are litert-community/Phonon-2's bytes). Text = the token ids decoded with the repo's tokenizer.json (repeated ids kept). Accuracy is WER against reference P_ii (transformers 5.20.2 ParakeetForTDT in float32 with the weights read out of Phonon-2.5 English's container, the same windows with a valid-length mask, the same greedy TDT decoding), with both the open-asr-leaderboard formula (L) and jiwer (J); sets from hf-audio/open-asr-leaderboard @ de79e57a. This file: phonon25en_mel_25s.tflite (2,576,644 B), windows up to 25 s; the log-mel front end for windows up to 25 s on the CPU (pre-emphasis 0.97, STFT n_fft 512 / win 400 / hop 160, Slaney mel 128, log, per-window normalization over the valid frames; no weights); the same bytes as litert-community/Phonon-2's phonon2_mel_25s.tflite (Hub LFS sha256 at af758518). artifact_sha256 = (source mel25.tflite) = the bytes the runs pushed (the phone's sha256 read-back MATCH in each frame) = the Hub LFS sha256 and size after the upload (litert-community/Phonon-2.5-English commit 9176312393c284427164a6c220ef4140c5930685, 17 files; 16 / 16 SAME) and at the anonymous read of 2026-11-08 23:37:05 JST (main aa84570511d15c2efc107a8880d6ba8216baf3ea, 2026-11-08T14:33:53.000Z, 17 files, public and ungated; its README.md = the card these records cite). Galaxy S26: the runs the card reads that load this file, and nothing else — CPU: S4 s3cpu_s4 (n2/s3); GPU: S4 s3gpu_s4 (n2/s3); NPU: P1 s2n_ls (n2/s2), P1 s2n_lso (n2/s2), P1 s2n_vox (n2/s2), S4 s1n_s4_b1 (n2/s1), S4 s1n_s4_b2 (n2/s1), timing s1t_npu7 (n2/s1). Runners: ultra_asr_runner_p7. Not records: the same hold's A B B A comparison of four and seven signatures (frame n2/s1b: its four-signature SM8850 file is not published, its seven-signature runs repeat the card's form), the S32 smoke runs, the author's own runtime's runs (frame n2/s4), the two-accelerator forms (not published), the card's usage-block runs and the Mac rows.
